meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去查你在 cmem.ai 上的 Claude-Mem 长期记忆,里面存着过去各会话(Claude Code、Cowork 等)带时间戳的观察记录。它先做宽泛关键词检索,再收窄到具体词,最后用大白话总结相关记录,不直接甩原始输出。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索记忆、问“你还记得 X 吗”,或需要项目、决策、文件等过往会话上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 会返回该项目相关的历史观察记录

say.text: 上个会话我们做了什么?
say.note: 会按时间戳整理上次会话内容

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 状态,搜不到东西
say.note: 会运行 status 看 API key 是否缺失

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai, where past-session observations are timestamped. It runs broad keyword searches, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language instead of dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to search memory, wonder what Claude remembers about something, want to know what happened last session, or need prior context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for notes about this project
say_en.note: Returns related observations from past sessions

say_en.text: What did we do in the last session?
Check claude-mem status, searches aren't working
say_en.note: Runs status to see if the API key is missing
